title: Cold dorms, lost millions: HBCU alumni sue Missouri over funding inequities - The Washington Post
description: Former students at Lincoln University are seekig more than $500 million in back payments, plus interest, saying unequal treatment compared to the predominantly White University of Missouri led to inadequate infrastructure and financial instability.

title: Lane Johnson’s retirement could create a cap mess for the Eagles in 2027 - NBC Sports
description: Eagles right tackle Lane Johnson said in August that 2026 will probably be his last year.

title: Trump interrupted by protesters as he fights to rally Texas voters behind Paxton in US Senate race - The Seattle Times
description: President Donald Trump fought to rally Texas voters behind Senate candidate Ken Paxton as a series of protests disrupted his rally in San Antonio.

title: Tropical Storm Isaias forms in Gulf, could reach U.S. as hurricane this weekend. See maps, possible path. - CBS News
description: Tropical Storm Isaias has formed in the Gulf and is expected to become a hurricane by Thursday before approaching the U.S. northern Gulf Coast on Friday, according to forecasters.

title: A thorium-229 optical nuclear clock with feedback loop - Nature
description: A thorium-229 nuclear clock is realized by stabilizing a continuous-wave laser to the 148-nm nuclear excitation with a rapid feedback loop based on absorption spectroscopy.
